newsitem.title: ITALY: MAS has first B777 to land at Fiumicino.
newsitem.headline: MAS has first B777 to land at Fiumicino.

text.p: A Malaysian Airline Systems Boeing B 777 landed at Fiumicino Airport on Thursday, the first aircraft of this type to be handled at Fiumicino.
A spokesman for AdR (Aeroporti di Roma) said that recent work at Fiumicino airport meant that this 'new generation' aircraft can use the airport thanks to telescope bridges.

In the new International Pier, there are 23 docking positions, 10 for large aircraft capable of handling five Boeing B 747/400 simultaneously , whilst two positions have been planned for the so called N.L.A.,(New Large Aircraft) or Super Jumbo, capable of carrying up to 900 passengers. There are with 13 slots for smaller aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
